method: Compared exact source sentence/expression/gloss and current decision with original owner sense, inspected exact changed owner fields and EN/ZH takeaway, confirmed all seven assessed fields of each owner byte-equivalent to Git HEAD, and independently tested 14 positive plus six negative live-JS target examples. results.evidence: Policy effects extending beyond the office are the same propagation metaphor as ripple out/through. The new send-ripples branch is a bounded causative frame; the timetable/deliveries takeaway supplies a plausible transmission link, with aligned Chinese.

The source reverses the owner’s compass-not-cage comparison to warn that pressure makes advice restrictive. Brief explicitly teaches reversed polarity; the mentor takeaway and Chinese reflect prohibition, not helpful direction.

Stretch their wings is an attested alternative to spread their wings for wider experience and independence. The source and trial-workshop takeaway fit that sense without implying total withdrawal of support; Chinese expresses an initial independent try.

detectorChecks.literalScopeLimit: The detector can also match a literal bird spreading or stretching its wings when a human possessive appears; source/lesson semantics, not regex alone, determine the figurative reading.
